edits.label: code
edits.mechanism: Delta += scale * 2 * (mu_code - mu_global) on row 2038 (' code') of BOTH model.embed_tokens.weight and lm_head.weight. Pooled class-conditional direction from the married fit set's final hidden states only.

edits.label: code
edits.mechanism: Delta += scale * bias_centered_code * m_hat on row 2038 of BOTH copies. Emulates the -||mu_c||^2 term of the nearest-centroid classifier as an effective per-class bias (h.m_hat near-constant per source: battery std 3.0, live std 6.6). Centered across classes.

edits.label: code
edits.mechanism: Delta += gamma_code * m_hat on row 2038 of BOTH copies. Cancels the input-side coupling offset of this patch (label rows are also input embeddings of the instruction's label tokens), offset measured source-balanced on the married fit set; gamma = 0.90 * gamma_full, the ridge-centre point of a bounded line search (see W1-RECOACH.md).

edits.label: mixed
edits.mechanism: Delta += scale * 2 * (mu_mixed - mu_global) on row 9519 (' mixed') of BOTH copies. The pooled mixed centroid is 40/41 battery by count — battery evidence is the only substantive mixed evidence (live mixed n=1, a measured geometric outlier); that is what keeps the class alive (see W1-RECOACH.md).

edits.label: mixed
edits.mechanism: Delta += scale * bias_centered_mixed * m_hat on row 9519 of BOTH copies. Same mechanism as W1R2-E2.

edits.label: mixed
edits.mechanism: Delta += gamma_mixed * m_hat on row 9519 of BOTH copies. Same mechanism as W1R2-E3. The mixed calibration is the largest of the three — the uncalibrated patch's coupling offset hits mixed hardest (-38.2 logits), as in round 1.

edits.label: model
edits.mechanism: Delta += scale * 2 * (mu_model - mu_global) on row 1614 (' model') of BOTH copies. The pooled model centroid carries the 9 live model documents at equal per-item weight; their large deviations (||dev|| 18.3 live vs 9.0 battery) give live geometry a pull well above its 9/49 count share — this is the term that repairs the dead model class.

edits.label: model
edits.mechanism: Delta += scale * bias_centered_model * m_hat on row 1614 of BOTH copies. Same mechanism as W1R2-E2.

edits.label: model
edits.mechanism: Delta += gamma_model * m_hat on row 1614 of BOTH copies. Same mechanism as W1R2-E3.

fit_set: 145 items, diagnostic only: E7 battery diagnostic 120 (40/40/40 code/mixed/model, experiments/wsp/e7/diagnostic.jsonl) + live diagnostic 25 (code 15 / model 9 / mixed 1, experiments/wsp3/live_diag_items.jsonl + live_diag_labels.jsonl). Sealed sets never opened: E7 held-out, wsp3 blind_sample/blind_labels, wsp3 scores.
formula: Delta_c = scale*(2*D_c + bias_centered_c*m_hat) + gamma_c*m_hat, scale=0.20 (the R4 dose ceiling, not above it). bias_centered = [code +3.8256, mixed -2.6776, model -1.1479]. gamma = t * gamma_full with t=0.90 and gamma_full = [-0.27521, +0.42316, +0.21306] (code/mixed/model) cancelling the source-balanced mean first-token logit offset [+24.83, -38.18, -19.22] of the uncalibrated s=0.20 patch; gamma = [-0.24769, +0.38084, +0.19175]. No mixed boost (contingency not triggered: shipped battery mixed recall 77.5%). Search budget: 9 registered grid configs + 5 refinement points around the ridge, in-memory argmax; 2 finalists generation-scored; selection = maximise min(battery-diag, live-diag) accuracy subject to per-class floors (see W1-RECOACH.md).
round: Phase 17 W1 re-coaching round 2 (mc dial specialist); round 1 = E7 round 1 (adopted Phase 15), untouched by this round
weighting: Scheme B (selected; see W1-RECOACH.md for the rejected schemes and their measured failures): round-1 pooled-centroid construction applied verbatim to the married fit set — every fit item equal weight (battery 120/145 = 83% of items, live 25/145 = 17%; per class: code 40 batt + 15 live, mixed 40 batt + 1 live, model 40 batt + 9 live). mu = pooled mean; class centroids pooled; calibration offset measured source-balanced (mean of the two per-source mean offsets) so the 25 live items carry half the calibration voice despite being 17% of items.
